fact: Makerere, Johns Hopkins and the Ministry of Health piloted the VectorCam AI mosquito-identification app with the National Malaria Control Programme from November 2022 to April 2024, with data posted to DHIS2, and will scale it to 22 districts.
title: VectorCam Project; Makerere, Johns Hopkins, and MoH to Scale Up AI-Powered Malaria Surveillance across Uganda
